figures.readback: The endpoint-linear inner-substep series plateaus near 1e-2, while source_panels_inner_1 and source_panels_inner_2 both follow the second-order guide and remain distinct admissible candidates.
All twelve convex grid/algorithm combinations pass the donor contract, while their angular-moment and nonconstant-profile errors visibly differ; no unique stencil is selected.
Both predeclared bounds 0.75 and 0.80 admit all twelve donor calls; the hostile near-unity bound, negative weight, and antipode cases fail closed.

Collision-outer and geometry-outer candidates approach the independent reference with first-order slopes. The central-K-sign mutation is strongly separated, while stage collapse and endpoint reversal are only weakly separated from the pristine discretization error.

Both fixed-Eulerian and evolved-Lagrangian histories retain positive coherency margins, yet they differ in state, observable, and direction association; validity does not select one semantic representation.
